settings.headline: Made for the lip filler appointment.
settings.subhead: UK-formulated topical preparation for the most common aesthetic booking. Clinical Strength suits most lip filler appointments. Advanced when the session asks more — top-up volume, longer chair time, or skin that runs on the sensitive side.
settings.image_alt: Editorial close-up of Senseless cream, lip-area context, no faces

settings.headline: Clinical for the everyday appointment. Advanced when you need more.
settings.body: Most lip filler appointments are short, focused, and sit comfortably in Clinical Strength territory — top-ups, a half-syringe, a single session. Advanced suits longer appointments, larger volumes, or sensitive lips. Professional is built for procedures that ask more of the skin than a lip filler appointment does. For the lips, save it.

settings.headline: The products built for lip filler prep.
settings.body: Cream is the default — Clinical for most appointments, Advanced when the session asks more. Gel for clients who prefer that application.

settings.headline: Lip filler appointments run on tight windows.
settings.body: Booking, prep, the chair, the recovery — often inside an hour, often before something else in the diary. The cream needs to suit that pace. Senseless is formulated for how lip filler appointments actually run. Not a generic skin cream stretched to fit an aesthetic use case.

settings.headline: What comes next.
settings.body: Most aesthetic appointments end with a treated area that needs gentle handling. The Senseless Foaming Cleanser is built for the hours after. An antibacterial cleansing foam that respects what you just had done.
settings.image_alt: Editorial image of the Senseless Foaming Cleanser on a clean countertop

settings.question: Which strength is best for lip fillers?
settings.answer: Clinical Strength for most appointments. Advanced if your lips are particularly sensitive, your appointment runs longer than a quick top-up, or you're having a larger volume done.

settings.question: Will Senseless make my lip filler appointment painless?
settings.answer: Senseless supports comfort during your appointment as a topical preparation. The specific experience varies between clients and depends on the procedure, the practitioner, and your sensitivity. Your practitioner is the best guide for what to expect.

settings.question: When do I apply it before my lip filler appointment?
settings.answer: Apply ahead of your appointment. The specific timing depends on your practitioner's instructions and your response to topical preparations.

settings.question: Do practitioners apply numbing cream during the appointment too?
settings.answer: Many do. Senseless is designed as preparation before your appointment, but practitioners may also apply additional numbing at the chair. Ask your practitioner about their protocol.

settings.question: Is it OK to use Senseless on my lips specifically?
settings.answer: Senseless is formulated for use on facial skin, including the lip area, as preparation before an aesthetic appointment. Follow your practitioner's guidance for your specific session.

settings.question: Is this a medicine?
settings.answer: No. Senseless is a UK cosmetic product. Not a medicine. Not a pharmacy product.
